criteriaInterpretation: Applied the frozen brief criteria, including coordinator clarification: twelve indexed runtime frames per state/facing, not twelve distinct RGBA hashes where the authored source repeats endpoints. No frame or motion was dropped.

inspectionCoverage.method: All 96 supplied sheets independently pixel-verified against all 192 exact raw native RGBA frames, then inspected through 16 review-only assemblies retaining each supplied light/gray/dark logical/native crop. Atlas cells independently verified pixel-exact against raw frames and original catalog rects. Four heroes inspected through verified four-view and all-frame surfaces. All 10 other declared image/index surfaces inspected directly or in the browser. All 24 MP4 previews independently probed at 12 frames/12 fps/1 second; actual browser players inspected at midmotion and end, including all eight source/candidate registered contexts.
inspectionCoverage.reviewOnlyAssemblies: reviews/round01-inspection/all-six-{idle,work,hold,load}-{N,E,S,W}.png. These are inspection crops, not edited candidate frames or final exports.
inspectionCoverage.packetRelativePathPolicy: Every entry in inspectedFiles is the exact path listed by packet.candidateRenders or packet.previews. The packet contains 130 previews, rather than the coordinator handoff shorthand count108.

scoreContext: Comparative visual evidence against the original and fixed target; these are not universal numeric approval thresholds.

observations.finding: The original blank rectangular cap is replaced by a compact gathered crown, curved band and rolled lower edge. It reads as a short chef cap with soft volume in all four facings. Rounded face, ears, curls, collar and cuffs are coherent native forms; silhouette stays inside the registered functional character scale. This is useful modeling improvement rather than a material-only repaint.

Warm dark brown skin and chocolate fringe/back curls remain distinct. Ivory hat/coat, teal apron, red tie and dark shoes retain Dalia identity. The new warm midtones avoid the original blown-white hat and the target orange/light skin drift. The palette stays coherent across every facing and action.

Broad restrained shading describes the gathered cap, curls, cheeks and garment layers. Side/back views retain readable volume without a preferred horizontal light direction. No target halo, background card, directional ground shadow, black overlap dead spot or blown cap patch is present in the inspected light/gray/dark outputs.

Folded collar, rounded cuffs, apron straps and buttons, bib/waist hierarchy, dimensional front pocket and small back knot make the clothing visibly constructed. The pocket opening and red tie remain readable at logical192x320. Details serve the chef role without turning into noisy microdecoration.

All 192 native frames retain clean silhouettes and planted shoes. Sleeve/hand transitions remain continuous through work/load extremes; no frame clipping, tears, topology popping, halo, coplanar stripes or material flicker was observed. Working blade remains visible in the side profiles and follows the right palm.

The hold/load salmon remains the honest original packed2D plane, with preserved source attachment and yaw/depth drivers. Its high face/chest presentation, N occlusion and asymmetric hand relationship are source composition caveats, not new candidate regressions. All source/candidate serving contexts show the same reach-and-return behavior and retained dish; no release or belt-flight trajectory is invented. Load ends at the authored returned hold pose and remains nonloop.

remainingDifferences: The fixed target has a tall puffed toque, larger presentation framing and longer/larger garment and shoe forms. The candidate keeps a short compact cap, nominal1.375 rest height, small planted shoes and registered chibi body scale as required.

Curls retain a regular grouped back pattern and the fabric treatment is broad and restrained; it does not reproduce every target seam, gloss highlight or decorative detail. The visible native modeling and shading improvement is sufficient under the frozen criteria.
Original2D salmon rendering remains stylistically more illustrative than the native chef. Its source-facing visibility and load attachment caveats remain explicit accepted constraints.

technicalEvidence.independentReopen: Reopened the sealed source/round-01.blend in Blender5.2.2 LTS and isolated the intended Dalia collection for all192 recorded native poses. No candidate project, images, target, inputs or brief were modified; no approval rerender was made.

registration.actualDirections: S0/E+90/N180/W-90 verified in all native frame records and actual asymmetric visible facings.

envelope.interpretation: Nominal rest height with original frame-by-frame bob/tilt allowance, not an invented flat top clamp. Biased original2D food plane is excluded from functional body footprint.

topologyAndRig.rigEvidence: Provided all-frame native geometry, weights, actions, contacts and loop records inspected. Idle/work/hold closing frame13 matches source; runtime atlases contain indices0-11 only. Load nonloop policy preserved.

resourcesAndLight.lighting: Independent reopened source has one200W overhead area and four equal35W cardinal area fills, same warm color, common scene/material configuration, transparent film and no ground-plane cast shadow.
resourcesAndLight.representation: 95 native3D meshes plus the one declared original packed2D salmon plane; knife handle/blade native3D; no full-character target plane.

technicalEvidence.pixels: Independent raw frame hashes, all16 atlas layouts/cells and all96 supplied-sheet frame crops pass. All frames remain inside alpha canvas. Every candidate hero/declared preview is covered in inspectedFiles.
technicalEvidence.actualPlayback: Chrome loaded all24 sealed MP4 players with readyState4 and1-second duration. At ~0.53s all24 were actively playing; later idle/work/hold continued looping, all4 native load and8 source/candidate contexts ended at1s. Browser screenshots inspected at active and endpoint phases. technicalEvidence.limits: Review applies only to exact bound candidate bytes. Review composites/contact markers/belt contexts are identified inspection evidence, not native final exports. Approval does not expand production or publishing authorization.
